card.name: Words just before an all-caps heading
card.fires_on: The word "see" in a parenthetical cross-reference right before an all-caps section name such as WARNINGS or PRECAUTIONS. It also fires on words that lead into capitalised keywords, such as "but" before WITHOUT WARRANTY and the bracket before VALUES in SQL.

modes.label: Label cross-reference
modes.description: "see" or "See" in parentheses, followed by an all-caps section heading.

modes.label: License or SQL keyword
modes.description: A word or bracket that leads into an all-caps keyword in license text or a SQL statement.

modes.label: Inside a drug name
modes.description: Partway through a drug name, such as probenecid, in an interaction sentence.

card.writes: It promotes all-caps keywords such as FROM, GET, SET, NOT and DELETE, so the next word is likely to be in capitals.
card.plain: It notices the spot where an all-caps heading or command word is about to come, mostly after "see" in a label cross-reference.
